column1: # Prewarm seed list (shipped in the app, next to shader_map.tsv). Rows: S<TAB>shader key<TAB>stage / R<TAB>render pipeline key (pso_skey hex) / C<TAB>compute shader key / M<TAB>task shader key or -<TAB>native task / mesh pipeline key (pso_skey hex: the mesh shader in the vertex place).

# Recorded on a MacBook Pro M3 Pro (macOS 27.2) on v131072, chain adec7d81d970, with no prewarm lists present (everything built on the spot): boot, the title and its movie, a new game and the opening, Link's house, Kokiri Forest, a save load.

# The 10,415 rows before the 4,959 iPad/Mac rows (5,249 S, 4,447 R, 719 C), from an iPhone 17 on v131072: the rows of its own pso_user.tsv after hours of play (to 2026-11-14 06:00) that this list did not have, every key parsed with pso_skey_parse and written again in the current layout first (that list held two layouts), and every shader key checked against shader_map.tsv. An IPA built with a Mac host gets the R rows' bases made offline (pso_offline.py --prewarm-host), so a device does not build them at its first start.

# The last five C rows were added by hand: compute pipelines built at Saria's greeting on a first start (Deku Scrub, Business Scrub, Deku Baba), found on an M4 MacBook Air (PR 1488); without a bundled pipeline archive (iOS) they are built there otherwise.

# The M rows at the end: native task / mesh pipelines built at their first draw, recorded on v131072 in Kokiri Forest, Hyrule Field, Castle Town and Hyrule Castle (PR 1368, its comments and PR 1488; 123 after duplicates).

# The last 41 M rows: 39 model pipelines behind the task shader a5288d0a6c4971fd_b and 2 foliage pipelines without one, recorded in later play (Death Mountain Trail among it); without them a cold first start on a Death Mountain Trail save built 9-10 of them at their first draw, up to 1.7 s each.

# The 4,959 rows before the MacBook Pro M5 capture (3,193 S, 1,579 R, 187 C), from an iPad Pro (M5) and a Mac on v131072: the rows of the iPad's own pso_user.tsv lists after hours of play that were not here, then the rows recorded on the Mac on first looks at new places with the iPad's lists as the device list (the forest bridge with Saria's farewell, Hyrule Field, the Lost Woods, Kokiri Forest). On iOS each render pipeline no list names is built at its first draw, 0.1-0.9 s each on the iPad.

# The 7,058 rows (3,565 S, 3,061 R, 297 C, 135 M), from a MacBook Pro M5 (macOS 27) on v131072 (discussion #3291, saifulakmalxi): the rows of its pso_user.tsv after play from 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-23 (Kokiri Forest and the Great Deku Tree, Hyrule Field, Castle Town, Hyrule Castle, Zora's Domain and Lake Hylia) that this list did not have; every R and M key parsed with pso_skey_parse / pso_mesh_skey_parse in the current normalized layout and every shader key checked against shader_map.tsv.
